newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,445 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,445 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,445 contracts compared with 2,162 overnight Thursday.
There were 289 wheat, 395 corn, 545 soybean, 144 soymeal, 58 soyoil, two oat, three soybean calls and nine soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to five cents lower, corn was 3/4 lower to 1/2 higher and soybeans were 1-3/4 lower to 1/2 higher.
